facts.fact: A presidential despacho signed by President João Lourenco in October 2026 orders public-tender contracting of training centres to raise digital skills of the working population, especially public servants, at basic, intermediate and advanced levels, with the head of the Instituto de Modernização Administrativa delegated to approve the procedure.

AGO.note: The despacho names the data protection agency (APD) and data-protection awareness training, but states nothing on a law.

facts.fact: A presidential despacho signed by President João Lourenco in October 2026 orders public-tender contracting of specialised centres to raise digital skills of the working population, especially young people and public servants, at three levels, with data-protection and cybersecurity awareness.

AGO.note: Training of the workforce, not government IT staff running systems.
